title: docs(flowchart): fix image node documentation
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

The documentation for flowchart image nodes is currently incorrect. It states that aspect ratio is maintained by adjusting the height (h) based on the width (w).

In reality, to resize an image while keeping the aspect ratio, you must set only the height (h) and enable constraint: on. Setting the width (w) instead causes inconsistent rendering and confusion, including incorrect interpretations by Mermaid AI.

This PR updates the documentation to clearly explain the correct usage and provides an example snippet for clarity.
